The 3rd Anniversary Villager Design Contest is
officially underway!🎉

This time, we’re bringing your creativity directly into
the game! You’re not just designing a
character—you’ll have the chance to make the
villager you create a real part of the Top Heroes
world! 🏡✨
Let your imagination run wild and design a
one-of-a-kind villager! Draw their unique appearance
and write a special introduction for them. Outstanding
entries may be selected, developed by our team, and
officially added to the game! 🎨✨

The next villager to join Top Heroes might just be the
one you created! 👀🔥

✏️ Event Duration: Now – September 15

✏️ Event Rewards
1st Place: $49.99
2nd–3rd Place: $29.99
4th–5th Place: $19.99
25 Additional Winners: $4.99 each
Entries from all platforms will be judged and
rewarded together.

✏️ Your Design Could Make It Into the Game!
The 1st–5th place designs may be developed based
on actual game requirements, with a chance to have
these player-created villagers officially added to the
game!

✏️ How to Participate
To join the event, simply prepare:
1. A villager design drawn by you 🎨
2. A villager introduction 📝
Tell us your villager’s name, personality, hometown,
favorite activities, or any other fun details! Let your
imagination run wild!
3. Your in-game nickname and Server ID
4. Please indicate whether your work was
AI-generated.

✏️ Event Notes
1. We’ll prioritize hand-drawn works during the final
selection.
2. Your entry must be your own original work. Do not
plagiarize, copy, or use other people’s works without
authorization.
3. The final winners will be selected by our art team,
and the official announcement will be final.
4. As winning villagers will need to go through design,
adjustments, modeling, and in-game development,
the actual production and release may take some
time.
5. Even if your work is selected as a winner, please
be patient while we work on bringing your villager to
life and officially adding them to the game. We’ll do
our best to move the process forward!
6. Winning designs may be adjusted during
development to better match the game’s overall art
style and actual development needs.
7. Event rewards will be distributed after the final
selection is completed. Please wait patiently.

🎉 Ready to get started?
Pick up your pencil and create a one-of-a-kind
villager! The next villager to step into the Top Heroes
world might just be the one you created! 🏡✨
